metadata.description: Three complementary evaluations: (1) sentence-length-stratified R2 in 4 bins with head-type cross-stratification, (2) head-type count reconciliation between 335-treebank and 294-treebank groupings, (3) residual variance (5.25%) contextualization via incremental R2 and literature benchmarks.

uid_word_order.source: Clark et al. 2023 (UID and word order); Maurits et al. 2010
